purpose: Source audit for municipality-based administrative/market wastewater coverage. This does not assert that every property is connected to public sewer; it verifies the utility brand responsible at municipality/owner-company level.
method: Plandata adopted sewer catchments are the baseline consistency check. Multi-municipality utility brands are additionally cross-checked against current official utility or owner-municipality sources.

verifiedGroups.evidence: DIN Forsyning states that it receives wastewater from all businesses and households in both Esbjerg and Varde municipalities, via sewer or septic-tank emptying.
Envafors is the shared service brand for the wastewater utilities in Næstved, Slagelse and Sorø; the underlying legal wastewater companies remain local.
Fors explicitly lists wastewater service in Holbæk, Lejre and Roskilde municipalities.
HOFOR lists one wastewater network company for each of the eight owner municipalities.
Greve's wastewater plan states that KLAR Forsyning handles and treats wastewater in Køge, Greve, Solrød and Stevns municipalities.
Gladsaxe Kommune lists the nine Novafos owner municipalities and states that the group companies handle water supply, wastewater and treatment in the owner municipalities' geographic areas.
Samn Forsyning states that it handles wastewater in both Horsens and Odder municipalities.
